note: Key names only, never values. Mirrors what the deploy adapters check: scripts/release/atomic-deploy-aphrody-stack.sh (Aphrody stack env files in /etc/aphrody). provision-aphrody-stack-env.sh --fresh-host writes the Aphrody keys; `aphrody-infra secrets check --service ID --env-file FILE` checks one file.

secrets.name: APHRODY_WEB_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL aphrody_web DSN (role aphrody_web, local)

secrets.name: APHRODY_SITE_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Compatibility alias, equal to APHRODY_WEB_DATABASE_URL

secrets.name: APHRODY_SITE_WEB_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Public Web client bearer (64 hex)

secrets.name: APHRODY_BXC_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Compatibility alias, equal to APHRODY_SITE_WEB_API_TOKEN

secrets.name: APHRODY_SITE_WEB_BACKEND_TOKEN
secrets.description: Upstream bearer, equal to the Web API BXC_API_TOKEN (64 hex)

secrets.name: BXC_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Backend bearer shared with the site (APHRODY_SITE_WEB_BACKEND_TOKEN)

secrets.name: APHRODY_WEB_DATABASE_URL

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

secrets.name: APHRODY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

secrets.name: APHRODY_AI_HTTP_TOKEN
